list_6_research_and_actor_developments.candidate_lens_A_ai_in_attacker_workflow: Three unrelated in-window disclosures put AI inside the attacker's own operation rather than in the marketing: Talos recovered UAT-10147's AI-generated ViewState playbook and four companion scripts from an open directory; the five-agency S7 advisory describes AI-developed Python tooling built on snap7 and dressed as OT monitoring software; and Insikt's PurpleDelta analysis records AI-generated photos and purpose-configured chatbot assistants answering interview questions in real time. Each is a different lifecycle stage — exploitation research, tooling, and social engineering.
list_6_research_and_actor_developments.candidate_lens_B_nothing_to_blocklist: Several of the week's items abuse vendor-supplied, working-as-designed functionality where there is no vulnerability to patch and no artefact to blocklist: Safe Mode with Networking and its service allow-list (Akira), BTR.sys as a required signed Defender component MSRC declined to service, application-specific passwords / device-code approvals / WhatsApp device-linking (GTIG's three Russia clusters), Ray's unauthenticated dashboard where authentication first exists in 2.52.0 and is off by default, Metabase's credential store which the patch does not empty, and TrueConf's own client-installer distribution channel. Needs a check that this is one honest lens and not four.
list_6_research_and_actor_developments.candidate_lens_C_exploitation_authority_: Four W34 flaws where the authorities disagree about exploitation, in BOTH directions: CVE-2026-33824 (CISA KEV vs Microsoft 'Exploitation Less Likely', record unrevised since 14 April), CVE-2026-55040 (CISA KEV vs Microsoft exploitation=no), CVE-2026-69836 (MSRC corrected to not-exploited within a day, ENISA EUVD exploited feed still carries it two days later), CVE-2026-73570 (patched 2026-07-21 with no CVE at all; identifier 2026-08-13; exploited 2026-08-18). Strongest candidate for weekly-top-stories: a triage process keyed on any single authority's exploitation field mis-ranked flaws this week in both directions.
